name: Soyuz-21
about: Soyuz-21 (1976-064A), a crewed vehicle (7K-T), launched 1976 Jul  6. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1976 Jul 19), held fixed
docked to S08911; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
